# aggregate.validate_sidecar_metadata { #healpyxel.aggregate.validate_sidecar_metadata }

```python
aggregate.validate_sidecar_metadata(
    sidecar_path,
    input_file,
    require_metadata=False,
)
```

Validate sidecar metadata file and check source file match.

Reads the ``.meta.json`` companion file for a sidecar parquet and
verifies that the recorded ``source_file`` matches the expected input
file. This prevents accidentally using a sidecar derived from a
different observation file.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name             | Type   | Description                                                                                                                      | Default    |
|------------------|--------|----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| sidecar_path     | Path   | Path to sidecar parquet file.                                                                                                    | _required_ |
| input_file       | Path   | Expected source input file path (matched by filename).                                                                           | _required_ |
| require_metadata | bool   | If True, raise ``FileNotFoundError`` when ``.meta.json`` is missing. If False (default), log a warning and return an empty dict. | `False`    |

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type   | Description                                                                                      |
|--------|--------|--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
|        | dict   | Metadata dictionary from ``.meta.json``. Empty dict if not found and ``require_metadata=False``. |

## Raises {.doc-section .doc-section-raises}

| Name   | Type              | Description                                                       |
|--------|-------------------|-------------------------------------------------------------------|
|        | FileNotFoundError | If ``require_metadata=True`` and ``.meta.json`` not found.        |
|        | ValueError        | If ``source_file`` in metadata doesn't match ``input_file`` name. |
